en:
Since we've come here, my curiosity 
has been constantly stimulated...
You have shown me beauty as well...

Your suffering and determination...
have been etched into my heart...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kiyo for a while?

It's gotten to the point where I have so many
notes, I cannot organize them on my own...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo and I spent some time
organizing his research notes.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo and I grew a little closer today.
